title: Mkpụrụ Obi A Na-akpọghị Aha Onye Guzogidere Mba Na-ezighị Ezi
intro: N'ime peeji nke Quran, e nwere ndị mmadụ e zoro aha ha ka anyị tụgharịa uche n'ihe ha mụtara. Otu mkpụrụ obi dị otu a mụrụ n'etiti mba jụrụ ndị ozi ya, mana onye a nwere okwukwe zoro ezo nke na-eme ka ha dị iche. Mgbe mbibi na-abịa, onye a guzosiri ike n'okwukwe nzuzo ya. Ị nwere ike ịchọpụta onye a bụ onye omimi a nke na-adọ ndị ya aka ná ntị tupu iwu ikpeazụ abịa?
clues: Ebi m n'etiti ndị jụrụ ndị ozi Allah zigara ha ugboro ugboro.
N'adịghị ka mba m, amatara m eziokwu ahụ mgbe onye ozi bịarutere na ihe ịrịba ama doro anya sitere n'aka Onyenwe m.
Ezochiri m okwukwe m n'ebe ndị na-emegbu m nọ, ebe m maara na ha ga-emerụ m ahụ ma ọ bụrụ na ha achọpụta ihe m kweere.
Mgbe iwu ntaramahụhụ ahụ rutere nso, m kwupụtara nrubeisi m n'ihu ọha ma dọọ ndị m aka ná ntị ka ha zọpụta onwe ha.
M chetaara ha na abụ m onye ozi a tụkwasịrị obi, ọ dịghị iche na ndị e zigara na mbụ, nakwa na ha ekwesịghị ife ofufe ma e wezụga Allah.
Ndị m boro m ebubo ịgba afa na ara, mana ntaramahụhụ ahụ ha dọrọ aka ná ntị mechara ruo ha aka.

identity.label: Ònye ka m bụ?
options: Onye Amụma Hud, onye ozi nye ndị Aad
Otu nwoke kwere ekwe si mba onye amụma Hud nke nwụrụ n'ihi okwukwe ya
Onye na-achị ndị Aad ​​nke jụrụ eziokwu
Onye enyi nke onye amụma Salih onye nwere obi abụọ banyere ihe ịrịba ama Chineke.
Mmụọ ozi e zigara ka o bibie ndị Aad
identity.answer: Otu nwoke kwere ekwe si mba onye amụma Hud nke nwụrụ n'ihi okwukwe ya

trial.label: Nnwale/Ihe Omume
options: Ọnwụnwa nke oké ọkọchị na ụnwụ nke nwalere ndidi ha
Ikpe nke ikwupụta okwukwe n'ihu mba na-ekweghị ekwe nke na-emegbu mmadụ
Ọnwụnwa nke ịrụ ụgbọ mmiri iji gbanahụ nnukwu idei mmiri
Ọnwụnwa nke ịtụba ya n'ọkụ maka ikwere na Allah
Ọnwụnwa nke ịbụ onye a nwalere na akụnụba na ọganihu
trial.answer: Ikpe nke ikwupụta okwukwe n'ihu mba na-ekweghị ekwe nke na-emegbu mmadụ

location.label: Isi Ihe
options: Obodo Makkah ebe e wuru ụlọ nsọ ahụ
Ala dị larịị nke mba ahụ nke gọnarịrị onye ozi ha
Ugwu Midian ebe ezitere onye amụma Shuaib
N'akụkụ osimiri Ijipt ebe a hụrụ onye amụma Mozis
Ndagwurugwu nke ndị Ad, nke ifufe siri ike kụrụ
location.answer: Ala dị larịị nke mba ahụ nke gọnarịrị onye ozi ha

outcome.label: Nsonaazụ
options: A zọpụtara m n'ụgbọ mmiri wee dịrị ndụ ruo mgbe Chineke chọrọ
Ndị m kwenyere mgbe m gasịrị ma duzie ha gaa n'ụzọ kwụ ọtọ
Ndị m gburu m mana ebere Chineke were mkpụrụ obi m.
Echegharịrị m mgbe a nwalechara m ule, Allah wee nabata nchegharị m
A gbanwere m ghọọ arụsị ndị obodo m na-efe mgbe m nwụsịrị
outcome.answer: Ndị m gburu m mana ebere Chineke were mkpụrụ obi m.

verse: And We did certainly send Moses with Our signs and a clear authority (11:96)
